title: LWS 1.0 storage description resource
description: Minimal data-model schema for a Linked Web Storage 1.0 storage description resource, derived from the LWS 1.0 core specification (lws10-core/Discovery.html, § storage description data model / representation). Published under https://w3id.org/lws/test/schema/json/storage-description; the harness serves the local copy under that IRI.

@context.description: MUST be an array starting with the URIs https://www.w3.org/ns/cid/v1 and https://www.w3.org/ns/lws/v1.

id.description: REQUIRED. The canonical URI of the storage; per CID-1.0 also the canonical URL of the controlled identifier document.

type.description: REQUIRED. A string equal to Storage, or a set of strings containing an item equal to Storage (case-sensitive).

capability.description: OPTIONAL. A set of capabilities; each capability is described by a map. Additional properties MAY be present.

id.description: OPTIONAL. If present, MUST be a URI.

type.description: REQUIRED. A string or a set of strings.

service.description: REQUIRED. A set of services; the set MUST contain a service whose type equals StorageRoot. Each service is described by a map. Additional properties MAY be present.

id.description: OPTIONAL. If present, MUST be a URI.

type.description: REQUIRED. A string or a set of strings.

contains.description: The set MUST contain a service whose type equals StorageRoot.
